<title level="1" right="Cantrip 1" pfs="Standard">
[Figment](/Spells.aspx?ID=1528)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=22" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Subtle" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=522" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 331

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) If a visual figment occupies the entirety of a 5x5 cube, it can provide cover or concealment, but not both, for a medium or smaller creature. It does not block line of sight._

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained
</row>

</column>

---

You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16) trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to [Create a Diversion](/Actions.aspx?ID=45) with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.
name: Figment
